mentions.name: WaxNerd
mentions.description: An AI-powered social platform for music discovery, described as 'the Goodreads of music'. It codifies the builder's lifelong music-nerd habits and heuristics for finding and curating music (new and old) so that anybody can use it to widen the range of music they listen to and share their taste with others.
mentions.audience: Anybody, i.e. music listeners of any background who want to widen their horizons and share their taste
mentions.source_excerpt: The Goodreads of music. I'm a lifelong music nerd and have developed habits for finding and curating good music, both new and old. I'm codifying my habits and heuristics for discovering new music into an AI-powered social platform that can be used by anybody to widen their horizons in terms of music they listen to and to share their taste with others. https://waxnerd.com/adnan
